title: Mischievous Goose Mod
description: This mod adds a silly little goose that basically ruins your day.
body: A fun challange alone or with friends that adds a goose that can do many mischievous and evil things. Also adds a few new items and a boss. The goose will hunt you down and cause mischief wherever you go so there's no point in running. **_Honk..._**
